答：B。

items.text: Read about Wang Bin: 'Wang Bin is my classmate. He is taller than me. He likes playing football after school.' Choose the best way to introduce him.（　　）。A．This is my friend Wang Bin. He is tall and he likes sports.　B．This is my friend Wang Bin. She is tall and she likes sports.　C．This is my friend Wang Bin. His is tall and he likes sports.　D．This is my friend Wang Bin. He tall and he likes sports.
items.source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
items.sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 介绍同学要用对代词：短文里说的是 He，所以后面两个句子都要用 he。
B 把 he 写成 she，人称代词错了；C 把主格 he 写成物主代词 his；D 少了 be 动词；只有 A 的人称和句子结构都对。
答：A。
items.hint: 先圈出短文里表示人的词（He），再数一数后面每句话的主语该用什么代词。
items.alternative: 也可以把四个选项里的 he、she、his、him 逐个划出来，和短文里的人对照。

items.text: Your friend asks: 'Where do you go after school?' Answer with a place.
items.source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
items.sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 问常去的地点用 Where do you ...? ，答句里的动词用原形 go。
回答要说出放学以后去的那个地方。
答：I go to the library.
items.hint: 注意问句里的 do 和答句里的 go 是怎么配合的。

items.text: Ask your friend a yes/no question to find out if she is in the library now.
items.answer: Are you in the library now?

items.sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
